info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Behavior Insights API
info.description: The Customer Behavior Insights API provides a detailed analysis of customer interactions and behaviors within banking services. By leveraging this API, businesses can gain valuable insights into customer preferences and transaction patterns, helping to tailor offerings and improve engagement strategies. This API is particularly useful for financial analysts, marketing teams, and customer relationship management professionals looking to enhance customer experiences through data-driven decisions. Get actionable insights into customer behavior to drive better financial products and services.
